notes: Fork topology: issues live upstream (Sniper7Kills-LLC/claude-plugins). Integration branches and member draft PRs live on the fork (Crank-Git/claude-plugins, git remote `fork`). The batch PR goes from the fork into upstream dev. The batch PR is merged by the operator, because GitHub does not let Crank-Git approve its own PR. Python is stdlib-only; each new script gets a scripts/test-*.py suite wired into .github/workflows/validate.yml.
